g0.rationale: §2.2 five-step test run on the frozen directions. Step 1: authoritative directions located (aggregated, moderate-high confidence). Step 2, mode by mode — (a) mask mode 'Nach dem Waschen sanft auf das nasse Haar auftragen und 2 bis 3 Minuten einwirken lassen, gründlich ausspülen': after cleansing YES, stated contact time YES, rinse YES → qualifies; (b) Pre-Shampoo-Behandlung: not after cleansing → fails; (c) Spülung nach dem Shampoonieren: after cleansing and rinsed, but no stated contact time → fails §2.1's contact-time conjunct; (d) Leave-in: no rinse → fails. Step 3: exactly one mode qualifies → classify only that mode, record multi_use: true and name the uncovered modes. Charter F1 governs; the marketing name '4-in-1' never decides.

The marker at 13 gives the cohort's second-longest above-tail segment and is what makes the gluconamide pair (@8/@9) qualifying here while the identical pair in #02 (ranks 11/12 against a marker at 8) is not. It also correctly demotes Amodimethicone @14, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter @15 and Prunus Armeniaca Kernel Oil @18 to decorative — the exact pattern lexicon §0.2 records for this product family.

adjudicationPoints.title: The operational `balanced` test is far looser than D6's 'substantive mixed architecture'
adjudicationPoints.body: D6 reserves `balanced` for a substantive mixed protein-plus-moisture architecture and forbids it as a middle bucket, noting it bridge-matches in the production fit layer so inflation has real downstream cost. §9.3's operational test, though, is 'material R5 route AND (humectant cluster OR S3 satisfied)'. The S3 leg needs only two distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids of ANY weight class above the tail — a condition met by most rich masks. The consequence in this cohort: #04 and #05 both reach `balanced` with no humectant cluster at all (one above-tail humectant each), purely on the lipid leg, while only #08 reaches it with genuinely substantive evidence on both sides. Three of twelve products on `balanced` is not obviously wrong, but two of them got there through a leg that has nothing to do with moisture. Candidate fix: require the second conjunct to be the humectant cluster, and demote the S3 leg to a confidence input.

adjudicationPoints.title: The shine threshold correctly refuses a Glanz-positioned bond mask — record it as the intended behaviour
adjudicationPoints.body: This product is named 'Liquid Silk Glanz' and its only alignment-oriented ingredient (Amodimethicone) is exactly one rank below the tail marker. §9.5.4 criterion 1 refuses shine, and criterion 3's claim corroboration is never reached. This is the standard working as designed, but it is worth putting in front of Nick alongside #11 (which DOES clear shine) so that the pair is reviewed together: the difference between them is not the strength of the gloss claim but whether the silicone is above or below the marker.
